description: This file defines the server-side logic for the login page in an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages web application. It handles user authentication, external login schemes, error handling, and transferring anonymous shopping baskets upon login.

classes.name: LoginModel
classes.description: PageModel for handling user login, external schemes, and basket transfer on login.

classes.name: InputModel
classes.description: Data transfer object for capturing user login input (email, password, remember me).

methods.name: OnGetAsync
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initialize login page, clears external cookies, and loads external login schemes.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests for login attempts, manages success, 2FA requirement, lockouts, and error handling.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketToUserAsync
methods.description: Transfers the anonymous user's basket to the logged-in user if a basket cookie exists.
